title: Certificate
description: One statutory certificate held by one vessel. Status (valid, expiring, expired) is derived from expires_on and is not stored.

vessel_imo.description: IMO number of the vessel that holds the certificate.

type.description: Matches the id of a card in knowledge/certificates/.

issued_by.description: Flag administration or recognized organization that issued it.

expires_on.description: Null only for certificates with no expiry date, such as some permanent registry certificates.

interim.description: True for interim or provisional certificates.

synthetic.description: True for made-up data. Every record in this repository must be synthetic.
